definitions.explanation: A general term encompassing both animal fats ({脂|あぶら}) and vegetable/liquid oils ({油|あぶら}). Used in food science, chemistry, and industrial contexts.

examples.english: To cut back on fats and oils.

examples.japanese: {動物性|どうぶつせい}{油脂|ゆし}と{植物性|しょくぶつせい}{油脂|ゆし}がある。
examples.english: There are animal fats and vegetable oils.

examples.japanese: この{食品|しょくひん}には{油脂|ゆし}{分|ぶん}が{多|おお}く{含|ふく}まれている。
examples.english: This food contains a high amount of fat.

notes:
Composed of {油|ゆ} (oil, liquid fat) + {脂|し} (fat, solid fat). This is the umbrella term covering both liquid oils ({油|あぶら}) and solid fats ({脂|あぶら}). Commonly found on food labels, in cooking discussions, and in scientific contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {動物性|どうぶつせい}{油脂|ゆし}: animal fat
- {植物性|しょくぶつせい}{油脂|ゆし}: vegetable oil
- {油脂|ゆし}{分|ぶん}: fat content
- {油脂|ゆし}を{含|ふく}む: to contain fat/oil

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {脂肪|しぼう}: fat — used for body fat or dietary fat in general
- {油|あぶら}: oil — the everyday word for cooking oil or oily substances
- {脂|あぶら}: grease, fat — refers to solid/animal fat specifically
